concerns.location: tasks.md (whole document) vs plan.md:Project Structure / constitution.md:Reproducibility Requirements
concerns.text: No task creates or pins `code/requirements.txt`, yet the plan's project structure lists it and the constitution makes it non-negotiable ('pins every Python dependency'; Code-Execution Agent builds an isolated venv from it). Without a task, T001–T012 cannot be executed in the mandated environment. Add a setup task (e.g., T000) producing `code/requirements.txt` with pinned versions.

The plan's structure defines `code/models/embedding_utils.py` (Model A vs Model B separation, a complexity-tracking decision), but no task explicitly implements it; T002/T003 only reference the models by name. Add an explicit deliverable or fold it into T002/T003 descriptions so the plan element is traceable.
